_comment: Shipped EMPTY on purpose. Maps short aliases to sets of project names as they appear in event logs (directory basenames). Used by cartographer-search.sh --project, /focus, cartographer-feed.sh, cartographer-pulse.sh, and build-profile.js. Build your own from your event logs: `node scripts/bootstrap-project-registry.js --dry-run`, then without --dry-run; it writes ~/.config/session-cartographer/project-registry.json, which REPLACES this file (the layers do not merge). Re-run with --update to add families for projects that appeared since. An undefined alias falls through as a literal project name.
